translations.idiomatic: The Baoxi clan also rallied neighboring tribes to revolt; Liang Jiong, patrol commissioner of Xia Prefecture, marched against them and restored order.

sentences.zh: 雍熙初，諸族渠帥附李繼遷爲寇，詔判四方館事田仁朗及閣門使王侁等相繼領兵討擊，並賜麟、府、銀、夏、豐州及日利、月利族敕書招諭之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi, tribal leaders of various clans joined Li Jiqian in raiding; an edict ordered Tian Renlang, commissioner of the Four Directions Office, and Wang Ren of the Gateway Office and others in succession to lead troops to attack, and simultaneously granted edict letters of enticement to Lin, Fu, Yin, Xia, and Feng prefectures and the Rili and Yueli clans.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongxi various chieftains rallied to Li Jiqian in raids; Tian Renlang, director of the Office for Foreign Relations, and Palace Gate envoy Wang Ren and others were sent in succession to campaign against them, while edicts of summons went to the prefectures of Lin, Fu, Yin, Xia, and Feng and to the Rili and Yueli clans.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，侁等於銀州北破悉利諸族，斬首三千六百餘級，生擒八十人，俘老小一千四百餘口，器甲一百八十六，梟偽署代州刺史折羅遇並弟埋乞，獲馬牛羊三萬計。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Wang Ren and others north of Yinzhou defeated the Xili clans, taking more than 3,600 heads, capturing alive eighty men, seizing more than 1,400 old and young, one hundred eighty-six sets of armor and weapons, displaying the heads of the falsely appointed Daiz Prefect Zhe Luoyu and his younger brother Mai Qi, and capturing on the order of thirty thousand horses, sheep, and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yongxi 2 Wang Ren routed the Xili clans north of Yin Prefecture, taking more than 3,600 heads and eighty captives together with some 1,400 noncombatants, 186 sets of arms, the heads of the self-styled Daiz Prefect Zhe Luoyu and his brother Mai Qi, and roughly thirty thousand horses and livestock.

sentences.zh: 五月，又于開光谷西杏子平破保寺、保香族，追奔二十餘里，斬首八百餘級，梟其首領埋乜已等五十七人，生擒四十九人，俘其老小三百餘人，獲牛羊馬驢凡四千余計。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, again at Xingzi Plain west of Kaiguang Valley they defeated the Baosi and Baoxiang clans, pursued the rout more than twenty li, took more than 800 heads, displayed the heads of chieftains including Mai Miyi—fifty-seven men in all—captured alive forty-nine, seized more than three hundred old and young, and captured on the order of four thousand sheep, cattle, horses, and donkeys.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month they also broke the Baosi and Baoxiang clans at Xingzi Plain west of Kaiguang Valley, pursued the fugitives twenty li, took more than 800 heads and the heads of fifty-seven chieftains including Mai Miyi, captured forty-nine alive with some 300 dependents, and seized roughly 4,000 animals.

sentences.zh: 又破保、洗兩族，俘三千人，降五十五族，獲牛羊八千計。

translations.literal: Again they defeated the Bao and Xi clans, captured three thousand people, received the submission of fifty-five tribes, and captured on the order of eight thousand sheep and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: They next defeated the Bao and Xi clans, took 3,000 captives, won over fifty-five tribes, and seized about 8,000 cattle and sheep.

sentences.zh: 侁等又言，麟州及三族砦羌人二千餘戶皆降，酋長折御乜等六十四人獻馬首罪，願改圖自效，爲國討賊，遂與部下兵入濁輪川，斬賊首五十級、酋豪二十人，李繼遷及三族砦監押折御乜皆遁去。

translations.literal: Wang Ren and others also reported that more than two thousand Qiang households at Linzhou and the Three-Clan Stockade had submitted; chieftains including Zhe Yumi—sixty-four men in all—presented horses and acknowledged guilt, wished to change course and prove loyal, and campaign against the enemy for the state; they then entered with their troops the Zhuolun River, beheading fifty enemy heads and twenty chieftains; Li Jiqian and Zhe Yumi, supervisor of the Three-Clan Stockade, both fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ren reported that more than 2,000 Qiang households at Lin Prefecture and the Three-Clan Stockade had submitted; sixty-four chieftains including Zhe Yumi brought horses in repentance and offered to serve against the rebels. They then entered the Zhuolun River with their men, taking fifty enemy heads and twenty chieftain heads; Li Jiqian and the stockade supervisor Zhe Yumi both fled.

sentences.zh: 旋命內客省使郭守文自三交乘驛亟往，與王侁等同領邊事。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the Inner Reception Bureau envoy Guo Shouwen was ordered to ride posthorses urgently from Sanjiao to go, and together with Wang Ren and others to take charge of frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Shouwen of the Inner Reception Bureau was then ordered to ride posthorses from Sanjiao to join Wang Ren in directing frontier operations.

sentences.zh: 五月，王侁、李繼隆等又破銀州杏子平東北山谷內沒邵、浪悉訛等族，及濁輪川東、兔頭川西諸族，生擒七十八人，梟五十九人，俘二百三十六口，牛羊驢馬千二百六十，招降千四百五十二戶。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wang Ren, Li Jilong, and others again defeated within the valleys northeast of Xingzi Plain in Yinzhou the Moshao, Langxi'e, and other clans, and the various clans east of the Zhuolun River and west of Toutou River; they captured alive seventy-eight, displayed fifty-nine heads, took two hundred thirty-six old and young captives, one thousand two hundred sixty sheep, cattle, donkeys, and horses, and received the submission of one thousand four hundred fifty-two households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wang Ren, Li Jilong, and others routed the Moshao, Langxi'e, and other clans in the hills northeast of Xingzi Plain in Yin Prefecture and the tribes east of the Zhuolun and west of Rabbit Head River, capturing seventy-eight alive, beheading fifty-nine, taking 236 dependents, 1,260 animals, and winning over 1,452 households.

sentences.zh: 六月，夏州尹憲等引兵至鹽城，吳移、越移等四族來降，憲等撫之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yin Xian and others of Xiazhou led troops to Yancheng; the four clans of Wuyi, Yueyi, and others came to submit, and Yin Xian and the others soothed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yin Xian of Xia Prefecture marched to Salt City; the Wuyi, Yueyi, and two other clans submitted and were reassured.

sentences.zh: 岌伽羅膩十四族拒命，憲等縱兵斬首千餘級，俘擒百人，焚千餘帳，獲馬牛羊七千計。

translations.literal: Fourteen clans of Jiagluoni resisted the order; Yin Xian and others unleashed their troops and took more than a thousand heads, captured and seized a hundred men, burned more than a thousand tents, and captured on the order of seven thousand horses, sheep, and cattle.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Jiagluoni clans resisted; Yin Xian's troops took more than 1,000 heads, a hundred captives, burned a thousand tents, and seized some 7,000 animals.

sentences.zh: 又降銀麟夏等州、三族砦諸部一百二十五族，合萬六千一百八十九戶。

translations.literal: Again there submitted from Yin, Lin, Xia, and other prefectures and the Three-Clan Stockade one hundred twenty-five tribes, totaling sixteen thousand one hundred eighty-nine households.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred twenty-five tribes from Yin, Lin, Xia, and the Three-Clan Stockade also submitted, totaling 16,189 households.

sentences.zh: 酋豪折御乜窮蹙來歸，守文置之部下。

translations.literal: The chieftain Zhe Yumi, hard pressed, came to submit; Guo Shouwen placed him under his command.
translations.idiomatic: Hard pressed, chieftain Zhe Yumi surrendered; Guo Shouwen took him into his force.

sentences.zh: 又夏州咩嵬族魔病人乜崖在南山族結黨爲寇，招懷不至，擒斬之，梟首徇衆，並滅其族。

translations.literal: Also, Moya of the Miewei clan in Xiazhou, a plague-stricken man of the Nanshan clan, formed a band to raid; entreaties failed to win him over; he was captured and executed, his head displayed to the multitude, and his clan was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Moya of Xia Prefecture's Miewei clan, a plague victim of the Nanshan tribe who had banded together for raids, spurned overtures; he was seized and executed, his head displayed publicly, and his clan was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 又府州女乜族首領來母崖男社正等內附，因遷居茗乜族中。

translations.literal: Also, Laimu Ya, Nanzheng, and others, chieftains of the Nümi clan in Fuzhou, submitted and inwardly attached; they were accordingly moved to reside among the Mingmi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Laimu Ya, Nanzheng, and other chieftains of Fu Prefecture's Nümi clan also submitted and were resettled among the Mingmi tribe.

sentences.zh: 七月，賜宥州界咩兀十族首領、都指揮使遇乜布等九人敕書，以安撫之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, edict letters were granted to Yu Miyi and eight others—chieftains of the Miewu Ten Clans on the Youzhou frontier and directors-in-chief—to soothe and reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month edicts of reassurance went to nine chieftains of the Miewu Ten Clans on the You Prefecture border, including Director-in-Chief Yu Miyi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以勒浪族十六府大首領屈遇、名波族十二府大首領浪買當豐州路最爲忠順，及兀泥三族首領佶移等、女女四族首領殺越都等歸化，並賜敕書撫之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because Qu Yu, great chieftain of the sixteen prefectures of the Lelang clan, and Lang Maidang, great chieftain of the twelve prefectures of the Mingbo clan on the Fengzhou circuit, were most loyal and submissive, and because Ji Yi and others, chieftains of the Wuni Three Clans, and Shayue Dou and others, chieftains of the Nünu Four Clans, had submitted in transformation—all were granted edict letters to soothe them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month edicts of reassurance went to Qu Yu of the sixteen Lelang prefectures and Lang Maidang of the twelve Mingbo prefectures on the Fengzhou route, the most steadfast allies, and to Ji Yi of the Wuni Three Clans and Shayue Dou of the Nünu Four Clans, all of whom had come over.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年三月，火山軍言河西羌部直蕩族內附。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Duangong, Huoshan Army reported that the Zhidang clan of the Qiang in Hexi had submitted inwardly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Duangong 1 Huoshan Army reported that the Zhidang Qiang of the Hexi region had submitted.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，夏州趙保忠言：「臣准詔市馬，已獲三百匹，其宥州御泥布、囉樹等二族黨附繼遷，不肯賣馬，臣遂領兵掩殺二百餘人，擒百餘人，其族即降，各已安撫。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, Zhao Baozhong of Xiazhou said: "Your subject, in accordance with the edict to purchase horses, has already obtained three hundred; the two clans of Yuni Bu and Luoshu and others in Youzhou sided with Jiqian and refused to sell horses; your subject therefore led troops in a surprise attack, killing more than two hundred and capturing more than a hundred; those clans then submitted and each has been soothed."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Duangong 2 Zhao Baozhong of Xia Prefecture reported: "Under the horse-purchase edict I have obtained three hundred mounts. The Yuni Bu and Luoshu clans in You Prefecture, allied with Jiqian, refused to sell; I raided them, killing more than 200 and capturing more than 100, and both clans have now submitted and been pacified."

sentences.zh: 詔書獎諭之。

translations.literal: An edict letter commended and instructed him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 十月，繼遷寇會州熟倉族，爲其首領咩㗭率來離諸族擊走之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Jiqian raided the Shucang clan in Huizhou; its chieftain Mieli led the Laili and various clans and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Jiqian raided the Shucang clan in Hui Prefecture; chieftain Mieli of that tribe and the Laili clans drove him back.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年，藏才三族都判啜尾卒，其子啜香來請命，乃令代其父。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunhua, Chuo Wei, chief judge of the Cangcai Three Clans, died; his son Chuo Xiang came to request appointment and was ordered to succeed his father.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 1 Chuo Wei, chief magistrate of the Cangcai Three Clans, died; his son Chuo Xiang petitioned to succeed him and was confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 二年七月，以黃乜族降戶七百余散于銀、夏州舊地處之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year, more than seven hundred surrendered households of the Huangmi clan were scattered and settled on the old lands of Yin and Xia prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Chunhua 2 more than 700 surrendered Huangmi households were resettled on former lands of Yin and Xia prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月，李繼遷居王庭鎮，趙保忠往襲之，繼遷奔鐵斤澤，貌奴、猥才二族奪其牛畜二萬餘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Li Jiqian was at Wangting garrison; Zhao Baozhong went to attack him; Jiqian fled to Tiejin Marsh, and the Maonu and Weicai clans seized more than twenty thousand of his cattle and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Li Jiqian was encamped at Wangting; Zhao Baozhong attacked him; Jiqian fled to Tiejin Marsh, and the Maonu and Weicai clans seized more than 20,000 of his animals.

sentences.zh: 十一月，繼遷寇熟倉族，刺史咩㗭率來離諸族擊退之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jiqian raided the Shucang clan; Prefect Mieli led the Laili and various clans and repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Li Jiqian again raided the Shucang clan; Prefect Mieli and the Laili tribes beat him back.

sentences.zh: 先是，兀泥大首領泥中佶移內附，詔授慎州節度，俄復歸繼遷，其長子突厥羅與首領黃羅至是以千餘帳降，府州折御卿以聞，降詔慰諭之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Ji Yi, great chieftain of the Wuni, had submitted inwardly and was granted the military governorship of Shenzhou, but soon returned to Jiqian; now his eldest son Tujieluo and chieftain Huang Luo came with more than a thousand tent households to submit; Zhe Yuqing of Fuzhou reported it, and an edict was issued to comfort and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wuni chief Ji Yi had submitted and been made military governor of Shen Prefecture, but soon rejoined Jiqian; now his eldest son Tujieluo and chief Huang Luo came over with more than 1,000 tents. Zhe Yuqing of Fu Prefecture reported the submission, and the court sent words of reassurance.

sentences.zh: 趙保忠又襲破宥州御泥布、囉樹二族，尋各降之，以其朋附繼遷，來上。

translations.literal: Zhao Baozhong again raided and defeated the two clans of Yuni Bu and Luoshu in Youzhou; soon each submitted; because they had sided with Jiqian, he reported upward.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Baozhong next broke the Yuni Bu and Luoshu clans in You Prefecture; both soon submitted, and he reported their earlier alliance with Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，直蕩族大首領啜尾、子河𣿭大首領馬一併來貢，詔以啜尾叔羅買爲本族都監，又啜尾下首領十人、馬一下首領十二人皆賜錦袍、銀帶、器幣。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, Chuo Wei, great chieftain of the Zhidang clan, and Ma Yi, great chieftain of the Zihe'e clan, came together in tribute; an edict made Chuo Wei's uncle Luomai chief overseer of the clan, and ten subordinate chieftains under Chuo Wei and twelve under Ma Yi were all granted brocade robes, silver belts, and ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Chunhua 4 Zhidang chief Chuo Wei and Zihe'e chief Ma Yi came in tribute; Chuo Wei's uncle Luomai was made clan overseer, and twenty-two subordinate chieftains received brocade robes, silver belts, and gifts.

sentences.zh: 是年，鄭文寶獻議禁青鹽，羌族四十四首領盟于楊家族，引兵騎萬三千餘人入寇環州石昌鎮，知環州程德玄等擊走之。

translations.literal: That year, Zheng Wenbao offered a proposal to ban green salt; forty-four Qiang chieftains allied at the Yang clan and, leading more than thirteen thousand cavalry, raided Shichang garrison in Huanzhou; Cheng Dexuan, prefect of Huanzhou, and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zheng Wenbao proposed banning trade in green salt; forty-four Qiang chieftains leagued at the Yang clan and invaded Shichang garrison in Huan Prefecture with more than 13,000 horsemen; Prefect Cheng Dexuan beat them back.

sentences.zh: 因詔屯田員外郎、知制誥錢若水馳驛詣邊，馳其鹽禁，由是部族寧息。

translations.literal: Consequently an edict ordered Tuntian Yuanwailang and Zhigao Qian Ruoshui to ride posthorses urgently to the frontier and lift the salt ban; thereby the tribes were pacified and settled.
translations.idiomatic: The court then sent Drafting Edict Officer Qian Ruoshui posthaste to the frontier to revoke the salt ban, and the tribes quieted down.

sentences.zh: 十二月，鹽州羌人酋長巢延渭爲本州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Chao Yanwei, a Qiang chieftain in Yanzhou, was made prefect of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Qiang chieftain Chao Yanwei was appointed prefect of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是年，藏才西族大首領羅妹來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Luomei, great chieftain of the Cangcai Western clan, came in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Cangcai Western chief Luomei came in tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，以綏州羌酋蘇移、山海㖡、母馱香三人並爲懷化將軍，野利、嵬名乜屈、啜泥三人並爲歸德郎將。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, the Qiang chiefs of Suizhou—Su Yi, Shanhai'e, and Mutuoxiang—were all made Generals Who Cherish Transformation; Yeli, Weiming Miyu, and Chuoni were all made Regiment Commanders Who Pacify Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Chunhua 5 Su Yi, Shanhai'e, and Mutuoxiang of Sui Prefecture were made Generals Who Cherish Transformation, and Yeli, Weiming Miyu, and Chuoni were made Regiment Commanders Who Pacify Virtue.

sentences.zh: 四月，府州折御卿言：銀、夏州管勾生戶八千帳族悉來歸附，錄其馬牛羊萬計。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Zhe Yuqing of Fuzhou reported: the eight thousand tent households of registered native clans in Yin and Xia prefectures had all come to submit, with horses, sheep, and cattle recorded on the order of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Zhe Yuqing of Fu Prefecture reported that all 8,000 native tent households under Yin and Xia prefectures had submitted, with livestock numbering in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 邈二族大首領崖羅、藏才東族首領歲囉啜克各遣其子弟朝貢。

translations.literal: Yaluo, great chieftain of the Miao Two Clans, and Suiluo Chuo Ke, chieftain of the Cangcai Eastern clan, each sent their sons and younger brothers to court in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yaluo of the Miao Two Clans and Suiluo Chuo Ke of the Cangcai Eastern clan each sent sons to court in tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月，繼遷所驅脅內屬戎人橐駝路熟藏族首領乜遇率部族反攻繼遷，其弟力戰而死，既敗繼遷之衆，復來歸附。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Miyi, chieftain of the Luotuo Road Shucang clan among the affiliated Rong coerced by Jiqian, led his tribe in a counterattack on Jiqian; his younger brother fought fiercely and died; having defeated Jiqian's host, he again came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Miyi, chief of the Shucang clan on the Camel Road whom Li Jiqian had coerced into service, turned his tribe against Jiqian; his brother died fighting, but they routed Jiqian's force and rejoined the court.

sentences.zh: 以遇爲檢校司空，領會州刺史。

translations.literal: Miyi was made Acting Minister of Works and given charge of Huiz Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Miyi was appointed Acting Minister of Works and prefect of Hui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是年，兀泥族首領黃羅內附，以爲懷化將軍，領昭州刺史。

translations.literal: That year, Huang Luo, chieftain of the Wuni clan, submitted inwardly; he was made General Who Cherishes Transformation and given charge of Zhaoz Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wuni chief Huang Luo submitted and was made General Who Cherishes Transformation and prefect of Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至道元年四月，以勒浪嵬女兒門十六府大首領馬尾等內附，以馬尾爲歸德大將軍、領恩州刺史，以勒浪樹李兒門首領沒崖爲安化郎將，副首領遇兀爲保順郎將。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Zhidao, because Ma Wei and others—great chieftain of the sixteen prefectures of the Lelang Weinü'ermen—had submitted inwardly, Ma Wei was made Grand General Who Pacifies Virtue and given charge of Enzhou; Mo Ya, chieftain of the Lelang Shuli'ermen, was made Regiment Commander Who Brings Tranquility, and the deputy chieftain Yu Wu was made Regiment Commander Who Preserves Obedience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Zhidao 1 Ma Wei, chief of the sixteen Lelang Weinü'ermen prefectures, submitted; he was made Grand General Who Pacifies Virtue and prefect of En Prefecture; Mo Ya of the Lelang Shuli'ermen was made Regiment Commander Who Brings Tranquility, and deputy chief Yu Wu Regiment Commander Who Preserves Obedience.

sentences.zh: 六月，賜慶州界首領順州刺史李奉明、澄州刺史李彥咩、鹽州刺史巢延渭、演州刺史李順忠、環州界首領會州刺史乜遇及靈州界並河外保安、保靖、臨河、懷遠、定遠五鎮等部敕書慰撫之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, edict letters of comfort and reassurance were granted to Li Fengming, chieftain on the Qingzhou frontier and prefect of Shunzhou; Li Yanmi, prefect of Chengzhou; Chao Yanwei, prefect of Yanzhou; Li Shunzhong, prefect of Yan Prefecture; Miyi, chieftain on the Huanzhou frontier and prefect of Huizhou; and the departments of the five garrisons of Bao'an, Baojing, Linhe, Huaiyuan, and Dingyuan beyond the river on the Lingzhou frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month edicts of reassurance went to Shun Prefect Li Fengming, Cheng Prefect Li Yanmi, Yan Prefect Chao Yanwei, Yan Prefect Li Shunzhong, and Hui Prefect Miyi on the Qing and Huan frontiers, and to the five garrisons beyond the river—Bao'an, Baojing, Linhe, Huaiyuan, and Dingyuan—on the Ling Prefecture border.

sentences.zh: 七月，睡泥族首領你乜逋令男詣靈州，言族內七百余帳爲李繼遷劫略，首領𠵚逋一族奔往蕭關，你乜逋一族乞賜救助，詔賜以資糧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, the son of Ni Miyi of the Shuini clan came to Lingzhou, saying that more than seven hundred tent households within the clan had been plundered by Li Jiqian; the Bipo clan of chieftains had fled toward Xiaoguan; the Ni Miyi clan begged aid; an edict granted provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the son of Shuini chief Ni Miyi came to Ling Prefecture reporting that Li Jiqian had plundered more than 700 of their tents; chief Bipo's clan had fled toward Xiaoguan; Ni Miyi's clan asked for relief, and the court supplied provisions.

sentences.zh: 環州熟倉族癿遇略奪繼遷牛馬三十餘，繼遷令人招撫之，癿遇答云：「吾一心向漢，誓死不移。」

translations.literal: The Qiyu of the Shucang clan in Huanzhou stripped Jiqian of more than thirty oxen and horses; Jiqian sent men to win him over by conciliation; Qiyu answered: "My heart is wholly turned toward Han; I swear I shall not shift even unto death."
translations.idiomatic: Qiyu of Huan Prefecture's Shucang clan seized more than thirty head from Li Jiqian; when Li Jiqian sent envoys to win him back, Qiyu replied: "My heart is loyal to the Song; I will never waver, even unto death."

sentences.zh: 詔以遇爲會州刺史，賜帛五十匹、茶五十斤。

translations.literal: An edict made Qiyu prefect of Huiz Prefecture and granted fifty bolts of silk and fifty jin of tea.
translations.idiomatic: Qiyu was appointed prefect of Hui Prefecture and given fifty bolts of silk and fifty jin of tea.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，以府州界五族大首領折突厥移爲安遠大將軍，父死來請命也。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Zhe Tujeyi, great chieftain of the Five Clans on the Fuzhou frontier, was made Grand General of Far Pacification—he came to request appointment upon his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Zhidao 2 Zhe Tujeyi, chief of the Five Clans on the Fu Prefecture border, was made Grand General of Far Pacification after petitioning to succeed his father.

sentences.zh: 六月，勒浪族副首領遇兀等百九十三人歸附，貢馬七匹。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Yu Wu and one hundred ninety-two others, deputy chieftains of the Lelang clan, submitted; they presented seven horses in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month 193 Lelang tribesmen including deputy chief Yu Wu submitted and presented seven horses.

sentences.zh: 遇兀舊隸契丹，淳化初，遷族帳於府州界，東至河百五十里，南至府州三百里，至是，始朝貢。

translations.literal: Yu Wu had formerly been subordinate to the Khitan; at the beginning of Chunhua his tribal encampments were moved to the Fuzhou frontier—one hundred fifty li east to the river, three hundred li south to Fuzhou; only now did he first come to court in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wu had once served the Khitan; early in Chunhua his people were moved to the Fu Prefecture border—150 li east to the river and 300 li south to Fu Prefecture—and only now came to court in tribute.

sentences.zh: 上召問慰勞，賜錦袍銀帶。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned him for questioning and comfort, granting brocade robes and silver belts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor received him, offered encouragement, and granted brocade robes and silver belts.

sentences.zh: 遇兀言部族多良馬，今始來朝，所貢未備。

translations.literal: Yu Wu said his tribe had many fine horses; having only now come to court, the tribute presented was not complete.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Wu said his tribe had many fine horses but that, having only now arrived at court, his tribute was incomplete.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「吾嘉爾忠順之節，慕化來歸，固不以多馬爲意也。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I commend your loyal and submissive integrity; you came in admiration of our culture—certainly I do not set store by how many horses there are."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I honor your loyal submission in coming to us; I do not measure your worth by the number of horses."

sentences.zh: 七月，李繼隆出討繼遷，賜麟府州兀泥巾族大首領突厥羅、女女殺族大首領越都、女女夢勒族大首領越移、女女忙族大首領越置、女女籰兒族大首領党移、沒兒族大首領莫末移、路乜族大首領越移、細乜族大首領慶元、路才族大首領羅保、細母族大首領羅保保乜凡十族敕書招懷之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, as Li Jilong set out to campaign against Jiqian, edict letters of enticement and reassurance were granted to ten tribes: Tujieluo, great chieftain of the Wuni Jin clan in Lin and Fuzhou; Yue Dou, great chieftain of the Nünu Sha clan; Yue Yi, great chieftain of the Nünu Mengle clan; Yue Zhi, great chieftain of the Nünu Mang clan; Dang Yi, great chieftain of the Nünu Yuansun clan; Mo Moyi, great chieftain of the Mo'er clan; Yue Yi, great chieftain of the Lumi clan; Qingyuan, great chieftain of the Ximi clan; Luo Bao, great chieftain of the Lucai clan; and Luo Baobaomi, great chieftain of the Ximu clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, as Li Jilong marched against Li Jiqian, edicts of enticement went to ten chieftains on the Lin and Fu frontier: Tujieluo of the Wuni Jin, Yue Dou of the Nünu Sha, Yue Yi of the Nünu Mengle, Yue Zhi of the Nünu Mang, Dang Yi of the Nünu Yuansun, Mo Moyi of the Mo'er, Yue Yi of the Lumi, Qingyuan of the Ximi, Luo Bao of the Lucai, and Luo Baobaomi of the Ximu.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，懷安鎮羌誘諸族寇慶州，監軍趙繼升率師擊敗之，斬首三百級，獲羊馬千計。

translations.literal: In the intercalary seventh month, Qiang of Huai'an garrison incited the various tribes to raid Qingzhou; the military supervisor Zhao Jisheng led troops and defeated them, taking three hundred heads and on the order of a thousand sheep and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month Huai'an garrison Qiang stirred neighboring tribes to raid Qing Prefecture; supervisor Zhao Jisheng routed them, taking 300 heads and some 1,000 animals.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，泥巾族大首領名悉俄，首領皆移、尹遇、崔保羅、沒佶，凡五人來貢馬。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, five men came to present horses in tribute: Mingsi'e, great chieftain of the Nijin clan, and the chieftains Jie Yi, Yin Yu, Cuibaoluo, and Mojii.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Zhidao 3 five Nijin chiefs—Mingsi'e, Jie Yi, Yin Yu, Cuibaoluo, and Mojii—presented horses in tribute.

sentences.zh: 名悉俄等舊皆內屬，因李繼遷之叛，徙居河北，今復來貢。

translations.literal: Mingsi'e and the others had formerly all been affiliated; because of Li Jiqian's rebellion they had moved to settle north of the river; now they again came in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Mingsi'e and the others had once been affiliated tribes; when Li Jiqian rebelled they moved north of the Yellow River, and now returned in tribute.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年三月，熟倉族癿遇來朝，真宗嘉其誠節，親見撫勞，賜以器幣。

translations.literal: In the third month of the first year of Xianping, Qiyu of the Shucang clan came to court; Zhenzong commended his sincere integrity, received him personally to soothe and encourage, and granted ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Xianping 1 Qiyu of the Shucang clan came to court; Emperor Zhenzong praised his loyalty, received him in person, and gave gifts.

sentences.zh: 十月，兀泥族大首領、昭州刺史黃羅對於崇德殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Huang Luo, great chieftain of the Wuni clan and prefect of Zhaozhou, was received in audience at the Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wuni chief and Zhao Prefect Huang Luo was received in audience at Chongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 兀泥族在青岡嶺、三角城、龍馬川，領族帳千五百戶，初隸繼遷，俄投府州，淳化中數敗契丹，及與繼遷相攻擊。

translations.literal: The Wuni clan was at Qinggang Ridge, Triangle City, and Longma River, commanding fifteen hundred tent households; at first they followed Jiqian, then soon went over to Fuzhou; in Chunhua they several times defeated the Khitan and also fought against Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: The Wuni held Qinggang Ridge, Triangle City, and Longma River with 1,500 tents; they had first served Jiqian, then shifted to Fu Prefecture; in the Chunhua era they repeatedly beat the Khitan and clashed with Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 及繼遷內附，黃羅懼，北徙過黃河。

translations.literal: When Jiqian submitted inwardly, Huang Luo feared and moved north across the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiqian submitted to the court, Huang Luo, fearing for his position, moved north across the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 今還舊地，遂入貢，且言繼遷既受朝命，不敢侵伐。

translations.literal: Now returning to his old territory, he came in tribute and added that since Jiqian had received court appointment, he dared not invade and attack.
translations.idiomatic: Now back on his old lands, he came to court and reported that with Jiqian under imperial authority he would not dare raid him.

sentences.zh: 上面加獎慰，賜齎甚厚。

translations.literal: The emperor on high added commendation and comfort, granting gifts very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him warmly and rewarded him generously.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔直蕩族大首領鬼啜尾于金家堡置渡，令諸族互市。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered that at Jinjia Fort a crossing be established under Gui Chuowei, great chieftain of the Zhidang clan, and that the various tribes be allowed mutual market trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court ordered Zhidang chief Gui Chuowei to establish a ferry post at Jinjia Fort for intertribal trade.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，以咩逋族開道使泥埋領費州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, Nimi of the Mietong clan, envoy for opening routes, was given charge of Feiz Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xianping 2 Mietong clan envoy Nimi was made prefect of Fei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月，以勒浪族十六府大首領、歸德大將軍、恩州刺史馬泥領本州團練使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Ma Ni, great chieftain of the sixteen prefectures of the Lelang clan, Grand General Who Pacifies Virtue, and prefect of Enzhou, was made regimental trainer of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Lelang chief Ma Ni, Grand General Who Pacifies Virtue and prefect of En Prefecture, was made regimental trainer of his prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月，藏才八族大首領皆賞羅等來獻名馬。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jieshang Luo and others, great chieftains of the Cangcai Eight Clans, came to present famous horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cangcai Eight Clans chief Jieshang Luo and others presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，以會州刺史癿遇爲保順郎將，蘇家族屈尾、鼻家族都慶、白馬族埋香、韋移族都香爲安化郎將。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, Qiyu, prefect of Huiz Prefecture, was made Regiment Commander Who Preserves Obedience; Qu Wei of the Su clan, Du Qing of the Bi clan, Mai Xiang of the Baima clan, and Du Xiang of the Weiyi clan were made Regiment Commanders Who Bring Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xianping 4 Hui Prefect Qiyu was made Regiment Commander Who Preserves Obedience; Qu Wei of the Su clan, Du Qing of the Bi clan, Mai Xiang of the Baima clan, and Du Xiang of the Weiyi clan were made Regiment Commanders Who Bring Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 九月，環州言，繼遷所掠羌族嵬逋等徙帳來歸，又繼遷諸羌族明葉示及撲咩、訛豬等首領率屬內附，並令給善地處之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Huanzhou reported that the Qiang clans Weibo and others plundered by Jiqian had moved their tents and come back; also chieftains including Mingyeshi of Jiqian's various Qiang clans and Pumie and Ezhu and others led their followers to submit inwardly; all were ordered given good land for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Huan Prefecture reported that Weibo and other Qiang tribes Li Jiqian had raided were returning; chieftains Mingyeshi, Pumie, Ezhu, and others also led their people in, and all were given good land.

sentences.zh: 其年，卑甯族首領喝鄰半祝貢名馬，自稱有精騎三萬，願備驅策。

translations.literal: That year, Helin Banzhu, chieftain of the Beining clan, presented famous horses in tribute, declaring himself to have thirty thousand elite cavalry and wishing to stand ready for deployment.
translations.idiomatic: That year Beining chief Helin Banzhu presented fine horses and claimed 30,000 elite horsemen ready for imperial service.

sentences.zh: 有詔慰獎，厚償其直。

translations.literal: An edict comforted and commended him and richly compensated the value.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commended him and paid generously for the horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，咩逋族開道使、費州刺史泥埋遣子城逋入貢，上嘉泥埋數與繼遷戰鬥有勞，授錦州團練使，以其族弟屈子爲懷化將軍充本族指揮使，城逋爲歸德將軍充本族都巡檢使，余首領署軍主以下名識者凡十數人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Nimi, envoy for opening routes of the Mietong clan and prefect of Feiz Prefecture, sent his son Chengbu to court in tribute; the emperor commended Nimi's repeated battles against Jiqian and meritorious service, appointing him regimental trainer of Jinzhou; his clansman younger brother Quzi was made General Who Cherishes Transformation and assigned as commander of the clan; Chengbu was made General Who Pacifies Virtue and assigned as chief inspector of the clan; more than ten remaining chieftains were given posts from army commander downward according to name and renown.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 5 Mietong envoy and Fei Prefect Nimi sent his son Chengbu in tribute; the emperor rewarded Nimi's repeated service against Li Jiqian by making him regimental trainer of Jin Prefecture, appointing his clansman Quzi General Who Cherishes Transformation and clan commander, Chengbu General Who Pacifies Virtue and chief clan inspector, and posting more than a dozen other chiefs in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 又以黑山北莊郎族龍移爲安遠大將軍，昧克爲懷化將軍。

translations.literal: Also, Long Yi of the Heishan Beizhuang Lang clan was made Grand General of Far Pacification, and Meike was made General Who Cherishes Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: Long Yi of the Heishan Beizhuang Lang clan was also made Grand General of Far Pacification and Meike General Who Cherishes Transformation.

sentences.zh: 八月，河西教練使李榮等向化。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Li Rong, drill envoy of Hexi, and others turned toward civilization and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Hexi drill commissioner Li Rong and others submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 其年，羌寇抄金明縣，李繼周擊走之。

translations.literal: That year, Qiang raided and plundered Jinming County; Li Jizhou drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: That year Qiang raiders struck Jinming County; Li Jizhou beat them back.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔河西戎人歸投者遷內地，給以閒田。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict ordered that Rong of Hexi who came to submit be moved to the interior and granted idle fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the court ordered Hexi tribes who submitted to be resettled inland and given vacant farmland.

sentences.zh: 時勒厥麻等三族千五百帳以濁輪砦失守，越河內屬，分處邊境。

translations.literal: At that time the three clans of Lejuema and others—one thousand five hundred tent households—because Zhuolun Stockade was lost, crossed the river and submitted inwardly, and were distributed along the border.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuolun Stockade fell, 1,500 tents of the Lejuema and two allied clans crossed the river to submit and were settled along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 邊臣屢言勒厥麻往來賊中，恐復叛去，乃徙置憲州樓煩縣，遣使賜金帛撫慰。

translations.literal: Frontier officials repeatedly reported that Lejuema went back and forth among the bandits and might rebel and leave again; he was therefore moved and settled in Loufan County in Xianzhou; envoys were sent bearing gold and silks to comfort and reassure.
translations.idiomatic: Border officers warned that Lejuema still mingled with rebels and might defect again; he was moved to Loufan County in Xian Prefecture and given gold and silk to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，咩逋族遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Mietong clan sent envoys to court in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Mietong clan sent tribute envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 上聞賀蘭山有小涼、大涼族甚盛，常恐與繼遷合勢爲患，近知互有疑隙，輒相攻掠，朝廷欲遂撫之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that on Helan Mountain the Xiaoliang and Daliang clans were very powerful and he always feared they might combine strength with Jiqian to become a calamity; recently learning they had mutual suspicions and repeatedly attacked and plundered one another, the court wished forthwith to soothe them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had heard that the powerful Xiaoliang and Daliang clans on Helan Mountain might join Li Jiqian and become a threat; learning recently that the two tribes were suspicious of each other and often raided one another, the court decided to win them over.

sentences.zh: 乃召問咩逋使者，因其還特詔賜之，以激其立效。

translations.literal: Thereupon he summoned and questioned the Mietong envoys; on their return he issued a special edict granting gifts, to spur them to establish merit.
translations.idiomatic: He then summoned the Mietong envoys, and on their departure sent a special edict with gifts to spur them to prove their worth.

sentences.zh: 上又謂樞密使王繼英等曰：「邊臣言遷賊舉兵，屢爲龍移、昧克所敗。

translations.literal: The emperor also said to the Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Wang Jiying and others: "Border officials report that the Jiqian bandit has raised troops and has repeatedly been defeated by Long Yi and Meike.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also told Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Wang Jiying and others: "Border officials report that the rebel Li Jiqian has taken the field and has been beaten again and again by Long Yi and Meike.

sentences.zh: 此族在黃河北數萬帳，或號莊郎昧克，常以馬附藏才入貢，頗勤外禦。」

translations.literal: This clan has tens of thousands of tent households north of the Yellow River; some call them Zhuanglang Meike; they often sent horses through Cangcai in tribute and were quite diligent in frontier defense."
translations.idiomatic: That clan numbered tens of thousands of tents north of the Yellow River—some called them Zhuanglang Meike—and they had often sent horses to court through Cangcai, serving diligently on the outer frontier."

sentences.zh: 六年，遂降詔獎慰之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict was issued to reward and comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 6 the court issued an edict commending and reassuring them.

sentences.zh: 二月，葉市族囉埋等持繼遷偽署牒率百餘帳來歸，以囉埋爲本族指揮使，囉胡爲軍使。

translations.literal: In the second month, Luomai and others of the Yeshi clan, bearing false appointment documents from Jiqian, led more than a hundred tent households to submit; Luomai was made commander of the clan and Luohu army commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Luomai of the Yeshi clan and others, carrying forged commissions from Li Jiqian, led more than a hundred tents in submission; Luomai was made clan commander and Luohu army commander.

sentences.zh: 邠寧部署言牛羊、蘇家等族殺繼遷族帳有功，上曰：「此族恃遠與險，久爲賊援，屢遣邊吏招諭，近聞有志內附，尚疑其詐，果能格鬥立效。」

translations.literal: The Binning deployment commissioner reported that the Niuyang, Sujia, and other clans had merit in killing Jiqian's tent households; the emperor said: "This clan relied on distance and rugged terrain and long served as the bandits' ally; border officials were repeatedly sent to summon them; recently we heard they wished to submit inwardly and still suspected deceit—but they have indeed fought and established merit."
translations.idiomatic: The Binning deployment commissioner reported that the Niuyang and Sujia clans had killed Li Jiqian's followers with distinction. The emperor said: "Those tribes had long aided the rebels from remote, rugged country; we had summoned them repeatedly and only lately heard they meant to submit, still doubting their sincerity—yet they have fought well and proved themselves."

sentences.zh: 詔厚賜首領等茶彩以獎激之。

translations.literal: An edict richly granted the chiefs tea and silks to reward and spur them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict richly rewarded the chiefs with tea and silks.

sentences.zh: 涇原部署言，者龍移卑陵山首領廝敦琶遣使稱已集本族騎兵，願隨軍討賊。

translations.literal: The Jingyuan deployment commissioner reported that Sidunpa, chieftain of Zhe Longyi on Beiling Mountain, sent an envoy saying he had gathered his clan's cavalry and wished to follow the army in punishing the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyuan deployment commissioner reported that Sidunpa, chief of Zhe Longyi on Beiling Mountain, had sent word that he had mustered his clan's horsemen and wished to join the campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 三月，以咩逋族首領泥埋領鄯州防禦使，充靈州河外五鎮都巡檢使。

translations.literal: In the third month, Nimi, chieftain of the Mietong clan, was made defense commissioner of Shaz Prefecture and assigned chief inspector of the five garrisons beyond the river at Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Mietong chief Nimi was appointed defense commissioner of Sha Prefecture and chief inspector of the five garrisons beyond the river at Ling Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時潘羅支已授河西節制，上以泥埋實與羅支犄角捍賊，故加恩寵。

translations.literal: At that time Pan Luozhi had already been granted Hexi command; the emperor, because Nimi in fact held a pincer position with Luozhi to defend against the bandits, therefore added favor and honors.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Luozhi had already been given command in Hexi; the emperor rewarded Nimi further because he and Luozhi formed a pincer against Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 是月，綏州羌部軍使拽臼等百九十五口內屬。

translations.literal: That month, Zhua Jiu, army commander of the Qiang in Suiz Prefecture, and others—one hundred ninety-five persons—submitted inwardly.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhua Jiu, a Qiang army commander of Sui Prefecture, and 194 others submitted.

sentences.zh: 原州熟戶裴天下等請率族兵掩擊遷黨移湖等帳，來求策應，部署司不報。

translations.literal: Pei Tianxia and others among the registered tribes of Yuan Prefecture asked to lead clan troops in a surprise attack on the Yihu tents of Jiqian's faction and came seeking coordinated support; the deployment office did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Tianxia and other registered tribesmen of Yuan Prefecture asked to lead clan forces against Yihu, a Li Jiqian ally, and sought coordinated support; the deployment office gave no answer.

sentences.zh: 上以戎人宣力禦賊，不應沮之，即詔諭諸路以精甲策應。

translations.literal: The emperor said that because the Rong were exerting strength against the bandits, they should not be discouraged; he immediately issued an edict all circuits to send elite armor in coordinated support.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said frontier tribes fighting the rebels should not be discouraged and ordered every circuit to send elite troops in support.

sentences.zh: 環州酋長蘇尚娘擊賊有勞，及屢告賊中機事，以爲臨州刺史，賜錦袍銀帶。

translations.literal: Su Shangniang, chieftain of Huan Prefecture, had merit in striking the bandits and repeatedly reported intelligence from among them; he was made prefect of Lin Prefecture and granted a brocade robe and silver belt.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Prefecture chief Su Shangniang, who had fought the rebels well and repeatedly reported their movements, was made prefect of Lin Prefecture and given a brocade robe and silver belt.

sentences.zh: 環慶部署張凝言：「內屬戎人興賊界錯居，屢爲脅誘。

translations.literal: Huanqing deployment commissioner Zhang Ning said: "Affiliated Rong intermixed with the bandits' territory are repeatedly coerced and enticed.
translations.idiomatic: Huanqing deployment commissioner Zhang Ning reported: "Affiliated frontier tribes living cheek by jowl with the enemy are constantly pressured and lured away.

sentences.zh: 臣領兵離木波鎮直湊八州原下砦，招降岑移等三十二族，又至分水嶺降麻謀等二十一族，柔遠鎮降巢迷等二十族，遂抵業樂，降𡗀樹羅家等一百族，合四千八十戶，第給袍帶物彩，慰遣還帳。」

translations.literal: Your subject led troops from Mubo garrison straight to the stockade below Bayuan in Baz Prefecture, receiving the submission of thirty-two clans including Cen Yi; then at Watershed Pass received the submission of twenty-one clans including Mamou; at Rouyuan garrison received the submission of twenty clans including Chaomi; then reached Yele and received the submission of one hundred clans including Shushuluojia—four thousand eighty households in all; robes, belts, and goods were granted in order, and they were comforted and sent back to their tents."
translations.idiomatic: I led troops from Mubo garrison to the stockade below Baz Prefecture's Bayuan and won over thirty-two clans led by Cen Yi; at Watershed Pass twenty-one clans led by Mamou submitted; at Rouyuan garrison twenty clans led by Chaomi; at Yele one hundred clans led by Shushuluojia—a total of 4,080 households. I gave robes, belts, and gifts in rank order and sent them back to their camps."

sentences.zh: 四月，繼遷寇洪德砦，酋長慶香與癿𡗀慶族合勢擊之，以砦兵策援，大敗繼遷，擒四十九人，墜崖死者甚衆，獲馬七十餘匹，旗鼓鎧甲數百計。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Jiqian raided Hongde Stockade; chieftain Qingxiang and the Qie Qing clan combined forces and struck him; stockade troops provided coordinated support; Jiqian was greatly defeated—forty-nine men captured, very many killed falling from cliffs, more than seventy horses taken, and several hundred standards, armor, and shields.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Jiqian raided Hongde Stockade; chief Qingxiang and the Qie Qing clan joined forces against him with stockade troops in support. Li Jiqian was routed: forty-nine captives, many dead on the cliffs, more than seventy horses, and hundreds of banners, armor, and shields taken.

sentences.zh: 上考陣圖以問入奏使，使者言砦兵拒賊千余步，慶香等親率部族與賊接戰，上曰：「慶香等假王師爲援，而交鋒俘獲，乃其功也。」

translations.literal: The emperor examined the battle diagram and questioned the memorial envoy; the envoy said the stockade troops held the bandits at more than a thousand paces while Qingxiang and others personally led their tribes to engage the enemy; the emperor said: "Qingxiang and the others borrowed the imperial army as support, but the clash, capture, and seizure were their achievement."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor studied the battle map and questioned the reporting envoy, who said stockade troops had held the enemy at bay a thousand paces while Qingxiang and his clansmen closed and fought. The emperor said: "They used the imperial garrison as a shield, but the fighting and the captures were their own doing."

sentences.zh: 悉與所獲物，加賜銀彩，以慶香領順州刺史，癿𡗀慶領羅州刺史。

translations.literal: All captured goods were given to them; silver and silks were added in gift; Qingxiang was made prefect of Shun Prefecture and Qie Qing prefect of Luo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They received all the spoils plus additional silver and silks; Qingxiang was made prefect of Shun Prefecture and Qie Qing prefect of Luo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河西內屬折勒厥麻等三族請以精兵千人、馬三百備征討，詔嵐州撫諭。

translations.literal: Three affiliated clans of Hexi including Zhelejuema asked to stand ready for campaigning with a thousand elite troops and three hundred horses; an edict ordered Lan Prefecture to soothe and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: Three Hexi affiliated clans including Zhelejuema offered a thousand elite troops and three hundred horses for the campaign; Lan Prefecture was ordered to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 環州白馬族與繼遷戰鬥，屢徙帳乏食，賜稟粟。

translations.literal: The White Horse clan of Huan Prefecture fought Jiqian, repeatedly moved their tents, and lacked food; grain rations were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Prefecture's White Horse clan, fighting Li Jiqian and repeatedly shifting camp, ran short of food and was given grain.

sentences.zh: 又詔洪德砦歸附戎人，給內地土田，資以口糧。

translations.literal: Also, an edict ordered that affiliated Rong who had submitted at Hongde Stockade be given farmland in the interior and supplied with rations.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered affiliated tribes at Hongde Stockade resettled inland with farmland and rations.

sentences.zh: 五月，唐龍鎮上言：鎮有貿易於府州者，爲州人邀殺，盡奪資畜。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Tanglong garrison reported that men trading at Fu Prefecture had been waylaid and killed by prefecture men, who seized all their goods and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Tanglong garrison reported that traders at Fu Prefecture had been ambushed and killed by locals, who seized all their goods and livestock.

sentences.zh: 乃詔府州自今許令互市，切加存撫。

translations.literal: An edict was therefore issued that Fu Prefecture from this time forward should permit mutual markets and earnestly soothe and care for them.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered Fu Prefecture to open mutual markets and treat the traders with care.

sentences.zh: 六月，瓦窯、沒劑、如羅、昧克等族濟河擊敗繼遷黨，優詔撫問。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Wayao, Meiji, Ruluo, Meike, and other clans crossed the river and defeated Jiqian's faction; a gracious edict comforted and inquired after them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Wayao, Meiji, Ruluo, Meike, and other clans crossed the river and defeated Li Jiqian's allies; the court sent a gracious edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 七月，補野狸族首領子阿宜爲懷安將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, A Yi, son of the Yeli clan chieftain, was appointed General of Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month A Yi, son of the Yeli chief, was appointed General of Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 八月，原、渭等州言本界戎人來附者八部二十五族，今詣吏納質。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yuan and Wei prefectures reported that affiliated Rong within their jurisdictions who had come to submit numbered eight divisions and twenty-five clans; they now came to officials to deposit hostages.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yuan and Wei prefectures reported that eight divisions comprising twenty-five affiliated clans had submitted and were now presenting hostages to local officials.

sentences.zh: 以環州蘇尚娘子孽娘爲臨州刺史。

translations.literal: Su Shangniang's daughter Nie Niang of Huan Prefecture was made prefect of Lin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Niang, daughter of Huan Prefecture's Su Shangniang, was made prefect of Lin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 府州八族都校明義等言，屢于麟州屈野川擊繼遷，及緣邊六七柵防遏，皆有克獲。

translations.literal: Mingyi and others, commanders of the Eight Clans of Fu Prefecture, reported that they had repeatedly struck Jiqian at Qunye River in Lin Prefecture and, along six or seven stockades on the border for defense and interdiction, had all achieved captures.
translations.idiomatic: Mingyi and other commanders of Fu Prefecture's Eight Clans reported repeated victories over Li Jiqian at Qunye River in Lin Prefecture and successful interdiction from six or seven border stockades.

sentences.zh: 詔獎齎之，仍令府州常以勁兵援助，勿失機便。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded and enriched them and also ordered that Fu Prefecture always send strong troops in aid and not miss opportunities.
translations.idiomatic: The court commended and rewarded them and ordered Fu Prefecture always to send strong reinforcements without missing a chance to strike.

sentences.zh: 二年，熟戶旺家族擊夏兵，擒軍主一人以獻。

translations.literal: In the second year, the registered Wangjia clan struck Xia troops and captured one army commander to present.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 2 the registered Wangjia clan defeated Xia forces and presented a captured army commander.

sentences.zh: 環州言：「戎人入寇，擊走之，擒酋將慶𡗀送闕下，請斬於槁街。」

translations.literal: Huan Prefecture reported: "Rong raiders invaded; we drove them off and captured the chieftain-general Qingzhao, sending him to the capital and asking that he be executed at Gaojie."
translations.idiomatic: Huan Prefecture reported: "Enemy tribes raided; we beat them back and captured chief-general Qingzhao, whom we have sent to court with a request that he be executed at Gaojie."

sentences.zh: 上特貰死，配淮南。

translations.literal: The emperor specially pardoned him from death and assigned him to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor specially spared his life and exiled him to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 原州野狸族首領廝多逋丹卒，其子阿酌代爲首領，且乞奉料。

translations.literal: Siduobodan, chieftain of the Yeli clan in Yuan Prefecture, died; his son Azhuo succeeded as chieftain and also begged a stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Siduobodan, chief of Yuan Prefecture's Yeli clan, died; his son Azhuo succeeded him and asked for a stipend.

sentences.zh: 詔諭以立功則賜之。

translations.literal: An edict instructed that if he established merit he would be granted it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told him stipends would follow meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 三年，府州折惟昌言兀泥族大首領名崖從父盛佶，爲趙德明白池軍主，密遣使諭名崖雲，德明雖外托修貢之名，而點閱兵馬尤急，必恐劫掠山界，名崖以告。

translations.literal: In the third year, Zhe Weichang of Fu Prefecture reported that Shengji, uncle of Mingya, great chieftain of the Wuni clan, being army commander at Baichi for Zhao Deming, secretly sent an envoy instructing Mingya that although Deming outwardly claimed the name of repairing tribute, he was especially urgent in reviewing troops and horses and surely feared raids on the mountain frontier; Mingya reported this.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 3 Zhe Weichang of Fu Prefecture reported that Shengji, uncle of Wuni great chief Mingya and a Baichi army commander under Zhao Deming, had secretly warned Mingya that Deming, though professing tribute, was urgently mustering troops and likely planned raids on the mountain frontier; Mingya had reported this.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，降詔撫諭，就賜錦袍銀帶。

translations.literal: The emperor commended this; an edict comforted and instructed him, and on the spot brocade robes and silver belts were granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the report, sent an edict of reassurance, and granted brocade robes and silver belts on the spot.

sentences.zh: 九月，秦州言野兒和尚族部落尤大，能稟朝命，凡諸族爲寇盜者輒遏絕之，請加旌別。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Qin Prefecture reported that the Ye'er Heshang clan's tribe was especially large, able to follow the court's commands; whenever other clans acted as raiders and bandits they would cut them off; they asked for special distinction.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Qin Prefecture reported that the large Ye'er Heshang clan obeyed the court and blocked other tribes from raiding, and asked that they be specially honored.

sentences.zh: 詔補三砦都首領。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him chief overseer of the three stockades.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him chief overseer of three stockades.

sentences.zh: 十一月，鎮戎軍曹瑋言叛去酋長蘇尚娘復求歸附。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Cao Wei of Zhenrong Army reported that the defected chieftain Su Shangniang again sought to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Cao Wei of Zhenrong Army reported that the renegade chief Su Shangniang was again asking to submit.

sentences.zh: 詔報瑋曰：「尚娘反覆無信，特恐狙詐，以誤邊吏，又使德明緣此爲詞，不可納也。」

translations.literal: An edict replied to Wei: "Shangniang is repeatedly untrustworthy; I especially fear an ambush and deception that would mislead border officials, and also give Deming a pretext—he cannot be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: The court replied to Wei: "Shangniang has proven faithless time and again; I fear a ruse that would mislead our border officers and give Deming an excuse—do not accept him."

sentences.zh: 四年，唐龍鎮羌族來美與其叔璘不葉，召契丹破之，來依府州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Laimai of the Qiang in Tanglong garrison and his uncle Lin were at odds; he called in the Khitan to break Lin and came to rely on Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 4 Laimai, a Qiang of Tanglong garrison, feuded with his uncle Lin, called in the Khitan to destroy him, and fled to Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 璘、美非大族，嘗持兩端，頃亦寇鈔近界，發兵趣之，則走河之東曰東壥，契丹加兵，則入河之西曰西壥，地極險阻，介卒騎兵所不能及。

translations.literal: Lin and Laimai were not great clans; they had long held both sides; recently they also raided and plundered the near border; when troops were sent they fled east of the river to what was called East Zhan; when the Khitan added troops they entered west of the river to what was called West Zhan—the terrain was extremely rugged and impassable, and even light cavalry could not reach them.
translations.idiomatic: Lin and Laimai were minor clans that had long played both sides and lately raided the frontier; when troops approached they fled east of the river to East Zhan, and when the Khitan reinforced they slipped west to West Zhan—country so rugged that even light cavalry could not follow.

sentences.zh: 至是，上亦憫其窮而款塞，特優容之。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor also pitied their poverty and their coming to the border in submission and specially treated them with leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, pitying their destitution and their submission at the border, treated them with special leniency.

sentences.zh: 會契丹使至，即令諭其事，仍還所掠璘、美人畜。

translations.literal: When a Khitan envoy arrived, he was immediately ordered to explain the matter and also to return the people and livestock seized from Lin and Laimai.
translations.idiomatic: When a Khitan envoy arrived, the court had him instructed in the matter and ordered the return of people and livestock taken from Lin and Laimai.

sentences.zh: 其族人懷正又與璘互相讎劫，側近帳族不寧，詔遣使召而盟之，依本俗法和斷。

translations.literal: Their clansman Huaizheng again mutually raided and revenged with Lin; nearby tent clans were unsettled; an edict sent an envoy to summon them and covenant them, adjudicating according to native custom and law.
translations.idiomatic: Their kinsman Huaizheng then feuded with Lin in reciprocal raids, unsettling neighboring camps; the court sent an envoy to summon both sides, bind them by oath, and settle the dispute under tribal law.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年，鄜延鈐轄言，小湖臥浪族軍主最處近塞，往時出師皆命爲前鋒，甚著誠節。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the Fuyan military commissioner reported that the army commander of the Xiaohu Wolang clan was nearest the border; in past campaigns he had always been ordered as vanguard and had shown very great loyal integrity.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 1 the Fuyan military commissioner reported that the Xiaohu Wolang clan's army commander, posted nearest the border, had always served as vanguard on campaign and had shown outstanding loyalty.

sentences.zh: 詔補侍禁。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，麟府鈐轄言杜慶族依援唐龍鎮，數侵別帳，請發熟戶兵擊之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year, the Linfu military commissioner reported that the Du Qing clan, relying on Tanglong garrison, repeatedly raided other tents and asked that registered tribe troops be sent to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Xiangfu 2 the Linfu military commissioner reported that the Du Qing clan, backed by Tanglong garrison, had repeatedly raided neighboring tents and asked for registered tribal troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「戎落皆吾民也，宜以道撫之。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The Rong tribes are all our people; they should be soothed by the Way."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "These frontier peoples are all our subjects; they should be governed with kindness."

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: He did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 其年，兀泥族大首領名崖同府州折惟昌入貢，上親加撫問，特詔副都知張繼能賜射于瓊林苑。

translations.literal: That year, Mingya, great chieftain of the Wuni clan, came in tribute together with Zhe Weichang of Fu Prefecture; the emperor personally added comfort and inquiry; a special edict granted Deputy Capital Gate Director Zhang Jineng archery at Qilin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wuni great chief Mingya came in tribute with Zhe Weichang of Fu Prefecture; the emperor received them personally, and a special edict granted Deputy Capital Gate Director Zhang Jineng an archery display at Qilin Garden.

sentences.zh: 四年，藏才西族、中族首領奴移、橫全等並遣子來朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the chieftains Nuyi and Hengquan of the Cangcai Western and Middle clans all sent their sons to court.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 4 chiefs Nuyi and Hengquan of the Cangcai Western and Middle clans sent their sons to court.

sentences.zh: 五年，環慶熟戶有酗酒劫奪使臣馬櫻者，上怒，令部署司重罰之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, registered tribes of Huanqing, drunk, robbed and seized the envoy Ma Ying's horses; the emperor was angry and ordered the deployment office to punish them heavily.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 5 drunken registered tribesmen of Huanqing robbed envoy Ma Ying's horses; the emperor was furious and ordered the deployment office to punish them severely.

sentences.zh: 六年，北界克山軍主率衆過大里河侵熟戶，爲羅勒族都囉擊走之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an army commander of Keshan on the northern frontier led his host across the Dali River to raid registered tribes and was driven off by Duluo, chief overseer of the Luole clan.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 6 a northern Keshan army commander crossed the Dali River to raid registered tribes and was beaten back by Duluo, chief overseer of the Luole clan.

sentences.zh: 詔以都囉爲本族指揮使，且諭邊臣約飭族帳，謹守疆界，勿出境追襲。

translations.literal: An edict made Duluo commander of his clan and also instructed border officials to restrain the clans, carefully guard the borders, and not cross the frontier in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Duluo was made clan commander, and border officials were told to restrain their tribes, hold the line, and not pursue across the frontier.

sentences.zh: 九月，夏州略去熟戶旺家族首領都子等來歸，隨而至者又三族，遣使存勞之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Du Zi, chieftain of the registered Wangjia clan plundered by Xia Prefecture, and others came to submit; three more clans followed; envoys were sent to comfort and encourage them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Du Zi, chief of the Wangjia registered tribe raided from Xia Prefecture, and others submitted; three more clans followed, and envoys were sent to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 七年，涇原鈐轄曹瑋請署熟戶百帳以上大首領爲本族軍主，次指揮使，又次副指揮使，百帳而下爲本族指揮使，從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jingyuan military commissioner Cao Wei requested that great chieftains of registered tribes of more than a hundred tents be appointed army commanders of their clans, next commanders, next deputy commanders, and those below a hundred tents commanders of their clans; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 7 Jingyuan military commissioner Cao Wei proposed that registered chiefs of clans over a hundred tents be named clan army commanders, with commanders, deputy commanders, and chiefs of smaller clans ranked below; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 五月，瑋言葉市族大首領豔奴歸順。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wei reported that Yannu, great chieftain of the Yeshi clan, had submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wei reported that Yeshi great chief Yannu had submitted.

sentences.zh: 七月，瑋又言北界萬子族謀鈔略，發兵逆之，大敗於天麻川，又爲魏埋等族掩擊，殺其酋帥，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Wei again reported that the Wanzi clan on the northern frontier planned to raid and plunder; he sent troops to intercept them and greatly defeated them at Tianma River; they were again ambushed by the Weimai and other clans; their chieftains were killed and more than a thousand heads were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Wei reported that the northern Wanzi clan planned a raid; his troops intercepted and routed them at Tianma River, and Weimai and other clans ambushed the survivors, killing their chiefs and taking more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 八年，北界酋長、指揮使浪梅娘等來投，諭邊臣令追取熟戶亡入北界者，即遣還梅娘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Lang Meiniang and others, chieftains and commanders on the northern frontier, came to defect; border officials were instructed to recover registered tribes who had fled into the northern frontier and immediately return them to Meiniang.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 8 northern chiefs and commanders including Lang Meiniang defected; border officials were ordered to recover registered tribesmen who had fled north and return them to Meiniang.

sentences.zh: 九年，羌兵寇小力族，巡檢李文貞率兵奮擊，追斬籍遇太保首級，賜文貞錦袍銀帶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Qiang troops raided the Xiaoli clan; inspector Li Wenzhen led troops in a fierce attack, pursued and beheaded Jiyu Taibao, and Li Wenzhen was granted a brocade robe and silver belt.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiangfu 9 Qiang raiders struck the Xiaoli clan; inspector Li Wenzhen attacked fiercely, pursued and killed Jiyu Taibao, and was rewarded with a brocade robe and silver belt.

sentences.zh: 五月，北界毛屍族軍主浪埋、骨咩族酋長癿唱、巢迷族酋長馮移埋率其屬千一百九十口、牛馬雜畜千八百歸附，降詔撫之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Langmai, army commander of the Maoshi clan on the northern frontier, Qiechang, chieftain of the Gumei clan, and Feng Yimai, chieftain of the Chaomi clan, led their followers—one thousand one hundred ninety persons and one thousand eight hundred mixed cattle, horses, and livestock—to submit; an edict comforted them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month northern Maoshi army commander Langmai, Gumei chief Qiechang, and Chaomi chief Feng Yimai led 1,190 followers and 1,800 head of livestock in submission; the court sent an edict of welcome.

sentences.zh: 天禧元年，環州言北界騎兵數千來剽熟戶，擊走之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianxi, Huan Prefecture reported that several thousand northern frontier cavalry came to plunder registered tribes and were driven off.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 1 Huan Prefecture reported that several thousand northern horsemen had raided registered tribes and been driven off.

sentences.zh: 二年，涇原路言樊家族九門都首領客廝鐸內屬，以廝鐸爲軍主。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Jingyuan circuit reported that Kesiduo, chief overseer of the Jiumen of the Fan clan, submitted inwardly; Kesiduo was made army commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 2 the Jingyuan circuit reported that Kesiduo, Jiumen chief overseer of the Fan clan, had submitted; he was made army commander.

sentences.zh: 三年，鄜延路言亡去熟戶委乞等六百九十五人，及骨咩、大門等族來歸。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Fuyan circuit reported that six hundred ninety-five defected registered tribesmen including Weiqi, and the Gumei, Daman, and other clans, had come back.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 3 the Fuyan circuit reported that 695 defected registered tribesmen including Weiqi and the Gumei and Daman clans had returned.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，又言宥州羌族臘兒率衆劫熟戶咩魏族，金明都監李士彬擊之，斬臘兒，梟七十二級，俘餘衆，獲甲馬三百餘。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, it was again reported that Lae'er of the Qiang in You Prefecture led his host to raid the registered Miewei clan; Jinming supervisor Li Shibin struck them, beheaded Lae'er, displayed seventy-two heads, captured the remaining host, and obtained more than three hundred sets of armor and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tianxi 4 the circuit also reported that You Prefecture Qiang chief Lae'er had raided the registered Miewei clan; Jinming supervisor Li Shibin attacked, killed Lae'er, displayed seventy-two heads, captured the rest, and took more than three hundred horses and sets of armor.

sentences.zh: 五月，小湖族都虞候喏嵬、巡檢胡懷節等擊賊有功，並進秩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Nuowei, deputy inspector of the Xiaohu clan, and Hu Huaijie, inspector, and others had merit in striking the bandits; all were promoted in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Xiaohu deputy inspector Nuowei, inspector Hu Huaijie, and others were promoted for distinguished service against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 環州七臼族軍主近膩納質歸化，以近膩領順州刺史，首領惹都等十五人補官有差。

translations.literal: Jinni, army commander of the Qijiu clan of Huan Prefecture, deposited a hostage and submitted in allegiance; Jinni was made prefect of Shun Prefecture; fifteen chiefs including Redu were appointed to offices according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jinni, army commander of Huan Prefecture's Qijiu clan, submitted a hostage and pledged allegiance; he was made prefect of Shun Prefecture, and fifteen chiefs including Redu received appointments of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 七月，撲咩族馬訛等率屬來附。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Ma E and others of the Pumie clan led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Ma E of the Pumie clan and others led their people in submission.

sentences.zh: 十月，以淮安鎮六族都軍主乞埋爲三班借職，充羌部巡檢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Qimai, chief army commander of the Six Clans of Huai'an garrison, was made Third-Rank Acting Office and assigned Qiang frontier inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Qimai, chief army commander of Huai'an garrison's Six Clans, was given Third-Rank Acting Office and appointed Qiang frontier inspector.

sentences.zh: 五年，北界羅骨等劫剽熟戶，環慶部署田敏追擊之，俘獲甚衆，詔獎敏等，賜器幣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Luogu and others on the northern frontier raided and plundered registered tribes; Huanqing deployment commissioner Tian Min pursued and struck them and took very many captives; an edict rewarded Tian and the others and granted ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 5 northern Luogu and others raided registered tribes; Huanqing deployment commissioner Tian Min pursued them and took many captives; the court commended Tian and his men and granted gifts.
